title: 41% of America's Electricity Comes From This #shorts
summary: In 2025 natural gas made about 41% of US utility-scale electricity, nuclear about 18%, coal about 17%, wind about 11%, solar about 7% and hydro about 6% (EIA).
sources: US utility-scale generation in 2025: renewables about 24%; natural gas about 41%, nuclear about 18%, coal about 17%, wind about 11%, solar about 7%, hydropower about 6% (EIA, Electricity explained: electricity in the US): https://www.eia.gov/energyexplained/electricity/electricity-in-the-us.php
